method: Re-recorded after merging main (PR #149: visible generated captions removed from photo page, modal and lightbox; alt prefers alt_text). This branch's own change is src/routes/links/+page.svelte: each gallery card's title is the event/matchup segment from splitAlbumNameForDisplay (canonical-album-naming.ts), with the level label as a small secondary line and the date line unchanged; album names are never reworded, only a trailing date duplicating the date line is dropped. Lead card alt keeps the full album name. A live 390px walk of /photography/links follows the deploy.
